description: r103 (11-19, the last hour of the 8x H100 AWS box): a timing run of track A with time_update_parts, to see where A 007's step goes (INBOX 11-19 01:32: whether A's 5 h can hold more than 467 steps). Not a score comparison: at most 140 steps (the box ends first, at about step 120-130; A's completions grow about threefold between steps 85 and 125, so the later steps are the ones that cost), no dev evaluation (eval_start_step 400), read by the t_part_* times, tokens/s and loss at matching steps. Base is r85's a007_ctl_h100m30 (A 007 with vllm_gpu_memory 0.30 for the 80 GB card); the directory sits under research_r85 so that the box's push loop sends its logs. As the baseline, with constrain_batched (the answer mask applied to the whole vLLM batch at once; the same mask), which track D has used since D 007 and track A never has.
